claim_ceiling: Candidate definitions only. No measured performance, SOTA, replication, or production readiness is claimed.
roadmap_boundary: Isolated parallel research track; does not change the post-Transformer product roadmap.

evaluation_policy.primary_objective: pre-registered task quality subject to multi-objective resource constraints

proposed_promotion_thresholds.notes: Thresholds must be pre-registered against the chosen primary task; they are not universal SOTA criteria.

architecture_candidates.name: dense_full_attention_baseline
architecture_candidates.hypothesis: A task-valid and reproducible dense decoder baseline is required before architecture effects can be interpreted.
prerequisites: freeze exact checkpoint or initialization and training recipe

architecture_candidates.name: dense_allocation_and_gqa_sweep
architecture_candidates.hypothesis: Hidden size, depth/width, MLP-to-attention parameter allocation and grouped-query attention can move the quality-throughput frontier under matched training compute.
required_controls: random-search policy at equal candidate-evaluation budget
prerequisites: architecture changes and training FLOP estimates validated

architecture_candidates.name: local_global_attention
architecture_candidates.hypothesis: Local attention plus explicit global-attention layers may reduce long-context cost while preserving cross-sequence composition needed by the task.
required_controls: equal context length and task mix
score by evidence position and context-length bucket
long-context realistic tasks plus synthetic diagnostics
prerequisites: local/global attention implementation and mask semantics verified

architecture_candidates.name: available_recurrent_or_state_space_baseline
architecture_candidates.hypothesis: A strong feasible recurrent/state-space implementation may offer better streaming or state-tracking efficiency on selected workloads, despite possible kernel and quality trade-offs.
architecture_candidates.preferred_reference: Mamba-3 only if exact compatible weights, license, tokenizer, implementation and target kernels are available; otherwise name the actual reference used.
required_controls: dense baseline on the same workload and target hardware

architecture_candidates.name: selective_full_attention_state_space_hybrid
architecture_candidates.hypothesis: Keeping selected full-attention layers while replacing other layers with a recurrent/state-space mechanism may improve a workload-specific Pareto frontier.
prerequisites: AE-SSM-01 measured or explicitly documented as unavailable

architecture_candidates.name: hdc_retrieval_sidecar
architecture_candidates.hypothesis: An HDC associative-retrieval sidecar may improve evidence retrieval or structured recall without replacing the language backbone.
required_controls: randomized or irrelevant retrieval negative control
retrieval latency/memory included in total cost
prerequisites: retrieval corpus and binding semantics frozen

architecture_candidates.name: context_local_adaptation
architecture_candidates.hypothesis: A bounded context-local update may improve long-context use more efficiently than additional generated thought tokens on selected tasks.
required_controls: prove per-request adaptation resets and base weights remain unchanged

search_policy_candidates.name: tpe_or_bayesian_optimization
search_policy_candidates.role: conventional adaptive-search control; use only if implementation is available and pinned

search_policy_candidates.name: symthaea_guided_search
search_policy_candidates.role: candidate policy; optimize measured task outcomes, not Phi alone

negative_controls.purpose: Search must not discover reliable gains when candidate outcome labels are shuffled.
negative_controls.expected: No reproducible signal above chance; otherwise the search-analysis pipeline is invalid.

negative_controls.purpose: Measure whether irrelevant/random HDC retrieval creates apparent gains or harms.
negative_controls.expected: No claimed retrieval benefit without improvement over backbone-only and relevant-retrieval controls.

negative_controls.purpose: An evaluator deliberately not conditioned on task text must be rejected by validation.
negative_controls.expected: Fail closed; no benchmark score promoted.
